style: Detailed pixel-art vehicle and original cast atlases

entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production transparent sprite atlas for a detailed pixel-art Taiwan arcade racer. This is ROSSO GT and its two existing Taiwanese adults.
ATLAS LAYOUT on a square 1536 by 1536 canvas (or square equivalent): upper region y=0..900 contains ONE complete rear-view red convertible with its two seated occupants. Leave y=900..980 entirely empty transparent. Lower region y=990..1480 contains TWO isolated waist-up character portraits with empty gap between them: driver left x=160..660; passenger right x=870..1370. Portraits must never overlap the car, frame or each other. No other views, no writing, no labels.
CAR: straight symmetrical rear chase view, slightly elevated enough to see cockpit and two heads; full vehicle including mirrors and tires within upper region x=100..1436 and y=80..890. Wide low original 1980s Italian wedge GT, vivid red layered fenders, rectangular red/amber lamp clusters, black horizontal rear grille, four exhaust tips paired left/right, blank black license, chunky rear tread, warm ivory interior. Wheels all grounded. Upper car's width:occupied height about 2:1. Same identity as ROSSO reference but a carefully finished new sprite.
CREW consistency: exactly TWO occupants facing forward away from camera, DRIVER on image LEFT: 阿凱 young adult Taiwanese man, short dark brown hair, sunglasses, WHITE casual shirt. PASSENGER on image RIGHT: 小晴 young adult Taiwanese woman, long warm dark-brown hair, RED top, warm fair skin. Heads are modest human proportions not giant chibi. Portrait lower-left shows same male in front three-quarter, confident relaxed face, sunglasses, white open-collar shirt. Lower-right same female in front three-quarter, expressive eyes/smile, long brown hair, red shirt. Refined expressive 1990s arcade character art, anatomically coherent shoulders and hands; faces distinct.
STYLE: detailed crafted pixel art, strongly visible consistent square clusters and sharp stepped edges, like 320px-wide source car and 96px-wide portrait upscaled nearest-neighbor. Selective deep navy outline, coherent warm sunlight and cool violet shadows, 5-8 hard tone steps per material, preserve detail in shadows. Strong red body volumes, metallic highlights are controlled pixel clusters. NOT glossy smooth CGI, not photoreal, not watercolor, not blocky placeholder, no random speckle texture. Genuine transparent alpha surrounding all three independent elements, transparent spaces in windshield. No checkerboard painted in, no ground shadow, no smoke, no environment, no UI, no brand logos, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas for FORMOSA RUN, detailed crisp 1990s arcade pixel art, richly shaded hand-placed pixel clusters, clean silhouette, saturated color, warm upper-left sunlight and cool violet shadow with retained detail; no smooth photoreal render. Genuinely transparent background, no checkerboard painted into art, no floor, no text labels, no logos or watermark. One square sheet: TOP region x0.04..0.96 y0.03..0.62 contains ONE entire centered straight REAR-view convertible with its two specified occupants seated naturally, facing away down the road; low chase camera with a little rear-deck visible, all mirrors and tyres in frame, tyres aligned on ONE horizontal ground line, car never tilted or posed, no extra heads, no characters in other seats. BOTTOM region y0.70..0.97 contains TWO separate detailed waist-up character portraits on transparent background: driver at x0.10..0.43, passenger at x0.57..0.90, facing viewer in a friendly 3/4 portrait; ample clear transparent gap above and between portraits. Bottom portraits are separate showcase art of exactly the same two cast identities seen seated above, so sheet has exactly one car and two portraits. Keep the top car broad enough and heads readable after sampling to original 136-pixel game width. Each model must be distinct geometry, not a red-car recolor. Vehicle: Yellow mid-engine open supercar with very wide squared rear haunches, prominent high rear wing, louvred engine cover, four round taillamps, narrow black central stripe, black disc rims, black cockpit; clearly distinct extreme wedge body. Driver (LEFT seat in rear view): 杰森: short blond hair, warm light skin, black shirt, dark sunglasses, self-confident adult driver. Passenger (RIGHT seat in rear view): 莉娜: burgundy/magenta bob haircut, warm light skin, golden-yellow shirt, lively adult passenger.
High polish character-specific faces: coherent anatomy, expressive eyes, no generic repeated faces. Each car model silhouette must be distinctive. Full rear width about twice occupied car height. Real transparent alpha. Keep upper car completely above y=0.62 and portraits below y=0.70, separating by clear negative space. Exactly TWO seat occupants.
